units.rawText: When I awoke from the Neural Cocoon, I found myself stuck underneath the ground in the Null Area near the Oasis... it might sound a tad unlucky, but the Sanctifiers didn't find me because I was in there.

units.rawText: Professor, I still dream of returning to my work in the real world, but I don't regret joining Project Neural Cloud, or standing by your side, or meeting everyone here. It's been a sad, difficult, and dangerous journey—but we've overcome it all, bit by bit.
